detail:
Full summary: Documented the minimal-PATH MCP spawn failure (README + UPGRADE-v2.md) and made the plugin's SessionStart hook detect missing npx: it now emits a loud warning and suppresses the gates instead of leaving twining silently absent. Plugin 1.11.1 → 1.11.2.
Decisions: [object Object]
Findings: The npx-missing warning path replaces the gates entirely in the SessionStart context — gates are unsatisfiable without the server, matching decision 01KWK9KV209JRSW70E32MYYDCX (hooks fail open when unsatisfiable). If a future config launches the server without npx (global binary, absolute path), the detector would false-positive; the warning text hedges but the heuristic is npx-specific.; Test simulation of minimal-PATH spawns needs a bash shim too: runHook resolves `bash` itself via the child PATH, so a shim dir must symlink bash, dirname, and cat for the hook to run at all under a stripped PATH.
